title: One-variable fields over a separably closed field
statement:
If $F$ is separably closed, then
$\operatorname{cd}_{\rm tor}(F(x))\leq1$, with the bound of
[def-sc-etale-torsion-cd].

proof.text: Reuse the existing proof of this same blueprint node, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.hasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE_one_ratFunc, from WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Curve.TorsionCohomologicalDimension. It gives Subsingleton (Sheaf.H G q) for every locally torsion abelian etale sheaf G on Spec F(x) and q > 1. This is an application of an already-proved declaration, not a new dependency or a renamed sorry. Its existing proof realizes the curve, purely inseparable base-change, and affine-limit argument, indexing by the nonempty affine opens of Spec F[X].

Apply the natural comparison isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-sheafH-ext-derived-comparison] at Spec F(x), q, and G. Its inverse is injective from derived-section cohomology to Sheaf.H G q. The latter is a subsingleton by the preceding step, so injectivity gives that the former is a subsingleton. Quantifying over G, its local torsion proof, q and q > 1 is exactly the required derived-section bound. Neither the field hypotheses nor the local torsion condition change.

split_report.blueprint: Realizes the entire proof paragraph of the blueprint node: localization stages, purely inseparable algebraic-closure base change, the affine-curve bound, and passage to the fraction field via lem-sc-cd-affine-limit.

tool_uses.why: Generic invariance of the etale topos and cohomology under a universal homeomorphism is needed for the purely inseparable algebraic-closure base change. The blueprint itself cites this tool from sk-prop-cd, and sk-prop-sf-cbc has no statement supplying it. This is a proposal for the maintainer, not an accepted top-level tool_uses record.
